# WARM NC

> > WARM NC is a Wilmington-based nonprofit organization providing home repair services and volunteer opportunities to ensure safe housing for vulnerable communities in North Carolina.

WARM NC coordinates volunteer groups, individual volunteers, and construction teams to repair and rebuild homes for families in need. The organization operates through community partnerships, fundraising campaigns like Mother's Day of Hope, and dedicated staff and board leadership.

## Key Topics

- Home repair and reconstruction
- Volunteer coordination and group volunteering
- Community service in Wilmington, NC
- Safe housing initiatives
- Nonprofit fundraising and donations
- Construction assistance programs
- Board governance and leadership
- Community partnerships
- Volunteer management
- Group volunteer events
- Home repair funding
- North Carolina housing support
- Volunteer requests and scheduling

## Get Involved

- [Donate to Fund Safe Housing](https://www.warmnc.org/donate): Support WARM NC's mission through donations to fund home repairs and volunteer programs
- [Volunteer As a Group](https://www.warmnc.org/grouprequests): Group volunteer opportunities in Wilmington - no construction skills required
- [Group Volunteer Requests](https://www.warmnc.org/event-details-registration/group-volunteer-requests): Submit group volunteer request form coordinated by Sadie Frye

## Events and Campaigns

- [Mother's Day of Hope](https://www.warmnc.org/mothersdayofhope): Annual Mother's Day of Hope event featuring home rebuilds and volunteer drives
